title: Andy Burnham delays taking stock  of UK’s relationship with EU
summary_full: PM to wait until after Brussels summit at which he hopes for agreements on food, farming and emissionsUK politics live – latest updatesAndy Burnham has said there is “no rush” to decide on the UK’s longer term relationship with the EU, as he comes under pressure from his own party to press the brakes on the pace of the rethink.The prime minister said he would “take stock” of the wider relationship after Friday’s summit in Brussels at which he hopes to secure agreements on food and farming, emissions trading and a youth mobility scheme.
